summary: Steep, narrow residential street with houses 4-12 m from the kerb.
reasons: Dwellings within 10 m along the stretch

drivers.seclusion: Houses line both sides, several within 4-10 m of the kerb; trees give cover but homes are close.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane, garden and tree edges, little clear ground to pull off; steep fall.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Only the odd car parked; no overnight parking habit visible.

flags: Houses within 10 m (4 m at 131 m, 8 m at 111 m)
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tree canopy on both sides.
